name: FulFill It Tracking
author: FulFill It

sections.description:
Paste your FulFill It site key (it starts with pk_) or the whole tracking script line into one box. The plugin checks it and adds the tracker to your site. Nothing is loaded until you save a key.

  • One field: bare key or full script tag. Only scripts from tracking.fulfillit.pk are accepted.
  • 7-day audit installs use the pinned t-a1.js script with its integrity (SRI) hash.
  • Optional, opt-in connection to the FulFill It emailing system.
  • “Check connection” button confirms the hub accepts your key and the tracker is on your home page.
  • Signed-in editors and administrators are not tracked.

External service

This plugin loads a script from, and talks to, the FulFill It tracking hub at https://tracking.fulfillit.pk (operated by FulFill It, https://fulfillit.pk). Terms and privacy policy: https://fulfillit.pk/privacy/

  • On every public page view (after you save a key) the visitor’s browser loads the script from the hub.
  • After a visitor stays on a page for a few seconds the script sends one request with: your site key, a random anonymous visitor/session id, the page path, referrer and campaign (UTM) parameters, and engagement time. It respects Global Privacy Control and the site’s consent signals.
  • When you press “Check connection” the plugin sends your site key to the hub once.

About FulFill It

  • Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/fulfillit.pk
  • Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/fulfillit.pk/
  • LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/fulfillit/

Privacy

  • No names, emails, IP addresses or form contents are stored by the tracker.
  • The email address you may enter under “Emailing system” is stored in your WordPress database only and is not transmitted by this plugin.
  • Deleting the plugin removes its settings.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin and activate it, or install it from Plugins > Add New.
  2. Go to Settings > FulFill It Tracking.
  3. Paste your site key or script and press Save.
  4. Press “Check connection”.
sections.faq:
Where do I find my site key?

In your FulFill It dashboard, or in the email we sent you. It looks like pk_ followed by 24 letters and numbers.

Can I turn tracking off for some pages?

Yes: add_filter( 'ffit_tracking_enabled', '__return_false' ); or any conditional callback.
